CREATE TABLE raw_ingest (
    ingested_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    source text NOT NULL,
    payload jsonb NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ingest_watermark (
    source text PRIMARY KEY,
    max_event_ts timestamptz
);

CREATE TABLE tag_map (
    tag_id text PRIMARY KEY,
    machine_id text,
    signal text,
    unit text,
    register text,
    scale double precision
);

CREATE TABLE machines (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    processing_time_s double precision,
    availability double precision,
    mttr_s double precision,
    work_power_kw double precision,
    idle_power_kw double precision
);

CREATE TABLE buffers (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    capacity int
);

CREATE TABLE stations (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    processing_time_s double precision,
    availability double precision,
    mttr_s double precision,
    work_power_kw double precision,
    idle_power_kw double precision
);

CREATE TABLE events (
    ts timestamptz NOT NULL,
    machine_id text NOT NULL,
    reason_code text,
    duration_s double precision,
    energy_kwh double precision
);

CREATE TABLE samples (
    ts timestamptz NOT NULL,
    machine_id text NOT NULL,
    tag text NOT NULL,
    value double precision
);

CREATE INDEX idx_events_machine_id_ts ON events (machine_id, ts);
CREATE INDEX idx_samples_machine_id_ts ON samples (machine_id, ts);

CREATE VIEW v_events AS SELECT * FROM events WHERE machine_id IN ('M1', 'M2', 'M3', 'M4', 'M5', 'M6');
CREATE VIEW v_samples AS SELECT * FROM samples WHERE machine_id IN ('M1', 'M2', 'M3', 'M4', 'M5', 'M6');
